# Auto-generated by gbarecomp
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(A2CE C CXX)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

if(MSVC)
    # /O1 not /O2: huge generated TUs (>2MB) make /O2's regalloc burn 20+ min/file.
    # /MP enables parallel cl.exe across files.
    add_compile_options(/W2 /wd4244 /wd4146 /wd4018 /wd4047 /wd4024 /O1 /MP)
    # clang-cl (a build farm): every block gets a label, most unused
    if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "Clang")
        add_compile_options(-Wno-unused-label)
    endif()
else()
    add_compile_options(-Wall -Wno-unused-label -Wno-pointer-to-int-cast -O1)
endif()

# No ImGui or mGBA dependencies - pure static recomp

add_executable(A2CE ${SOURCES})
target_include_directories(A2CE PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})

if(UNIX)
    target_link_libraries(A2CE PRIVATE m)
endif()

# SDL2 display
find_package(SDL2 CONFIG QUIET)
if(SDL2_FOUND)
    target_link_libraries(A2CE PRIVATE SDL2::SDL2 SDL2::SDL2main)
elseif(EXISTS C:/vcpkg/installed/x64-windows/include/SDL2/SDL.h)
    target_include_directories(A2CE PRIVATE C:/vcpkg/installed/x64-windows/include)
    target_link_directories(A2CE PRIVATE C:/vcpkg/installed/x64-windows/lib)
    target_link_libraries(A2CE PRIVATE SDL2 SDL2main)
else()
    # No SDL2 (a build farm, CI): a headless-only build, enough for
    # --headless runs, --record and the conformance harness
    message(STATUS "SDL2 not found: building headless-only")
    target_compile_definitions(A2CE PRIVATE GBA_NO_SDL)
endif()

if(MSVC)
    target_link_options(A2CE PRIVATE /STACK:16777216 /SUBSYSTEM:CONSOLE)
endif()
